About the Practice

The University of Arizona College of Medicine – Tucson is a public medical school offering a 4-year MD program focused on training physicians in clinical care, research, education, and public health. It provides comprehensive medical education with opportunities in primary care, various medical and surgical specialties through numerous residency and fellowship programs at affiliated hospitals, and offers unique programs like Commitment to Underserved People and Rural Health Professions Program, along with distinction tracks in areas such as bilingual medical Spanish, global health, and integrative medicine. Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Patients of the University of Arizona College of Medicine - Tucson who receive care through its partnership with Banner Health utilize the Banner Health Patient Account, formerly known as the MyBanner patient portal. This portal allows patients to access their medical records, schedule appointments, message their doctors, and request prescription renewals. The electronic health record (EHR) system primarily used by Banner Health, and therefore supporting the patient portal for care received at Banner facilities affiliated with the College of Medicine, is Cerner. Banner Health also utilizes eClinicalWorks for some practices within the Banner Health Network. Prior to switching to Cerner in 2018, Banner Health's Tucson facilities had used Epic.
